profiles.name: Joe Kent

profiles.status: Not declared; says the movement should start with a 2028 presidential run and is trying with Massie and Greene to draft Carlson, Aug 2026; registered Republican

profiles.core: I cannot in good conscience support the ongoing war in Iran. Iran posed no imminent threat to our nation, resignation letter Mar 17 2026
profiles.quotes: There was no intelligence that showed an imminent threat from Iran, to Carlson Mar 18 2026 | Last night was a referendum on the Iran war, Nov 4 2026 | It is money, at the end of the day, that destroyed the MAGA movement, Aug 2026 | I like JD, on Vance
